panel: Use case: product-mockup. Production background texture for a realistic MQ-9-inspired UNMANNED AIRCRAFT GROUND CONTROL STATION with a joystick flight-control desk, landscape 16:9. Photorealistic operator-console hardware, nearly straight-on from a seated operator looking slightly down. Matte charcoal industrial panels, brushed metal, robust screws, worn rubber keys, realistic soft cool daylight and subdued amber/green backlit legends. This is a ground workstation, NOT an aircraft cockpit. Three big physical monitor panels across upper half: left blank black-glass interior x=6%-33%,y=8%-55%; centre blank black-glass interior x=36%-63%,y=8%-55%; right blank black-glass interior x=66%-93%,y=8%-55%. Dark sturdy monitor bezels with a row of physical softkeys along bottom, and clearly separated desk below. Lower desk has communications panels, labelled inert safety covers, tactile keypad and radio console, no active numerical readouts. Left throttle mount at x=12%, y=79%, track/base only with NO handle. Right joystick mount and rubber boot at x=84%,y=80%, NO grip. Empty dark desk area at lower centre suitable for a physical controller. No people, hands, keyboard covering monitor interiors, sky, exterior view, game logos, fake radar contacts, fabricated aircraft position, fake surveillance video or decorative HUD. All screen interiors uniformly blank near-black, live maps and telemetry will be drawn by the application. Original realistic UAV control-desk texture.
grips: Uses the original F-16C generic HOTAS grip atlas from ../f16c/control-grips.png
usage: Original style-inspired panel artwork, not copied game imagery or a certified cockpit reproduction.
